SHR-L004An effects-only API called outside *.effects.ts

resource, mutation, stream, onDispose and navigate start or end work in the outside world. Keeping them in effects keeps every side effect of a module in one file.

Wrong

sheratan check reports SHR-L004.

Right

Checks clean.

In your terminal

sheratan explain SHR-L004          # this page
sheratan explain SHR-L004 --json   # the same, for an agent
Every example here is run by Sheratan's test suite: the wrong one must be caught with its code, the right one must not.
